video:video.video:title: Are the alerts actually helping?
video:video.video:description: Narrated demo: an administrator view that pairs published benchmark results with live clinician feedback on decision-support alerts. It shows aggregate figures only, suppresses small cells, and gives admins control of each agent's LLM transport.

video:video.video:title: Governance an auditor can verify.
video:video.video:description: Narrated demo: least-privilege role management with required reasons, a credential inventory that never shows secret values, and a searchable PHI access log where viewing the log is itself audited.

video:video.video:title: Designed to deliver alerts into the EHR providers already use.
video:video.video:description: Narrated demo of Health-Connect's EHR write-back administration against a vendor sandbox: per-connection settings, routing by recommendation class, pause controls, a needs-attention list and an audited hold release. Write-back is sandbox only and not live with any customer.
